 Solo Stove taps Marshawn Lynch for holiday campaign
 By 
 Dianna Dilworth 
 November 6, 2026 
 Solo Stove has kicked off a new holiday campaign starring former NFL running back Marshawn Lynch. 
 The “Gifts That Don’t Suck” effort pitches its products as great gifts for people who enjoy getting together with friends and family.
 The effort includes a contest in which people can share photos of “bad gifts” in exchange for Solo Stove prizes. In addition to the campaign, Solo Stove is donating $50,000 in products to Marshawn’s Fam1st Family Foundation.
 Solo Stove commissioned a survey by PollFish which found that 31% of consumers received a gift they didn’t like in the past year and 62% of people have faked excitement when opening a present. Additionally, more than 70% identified someone in their lives who gives the worst gifts. 
 The brand used these insights to create a playful campaign that promotes Solo Stove as a gift that people would enjoy getting – the research found 72% of people enjoyed receiving its products as a gift and that many of its stoves are purchased as gifts. The campaign also comes at a time when the brand has expanded its portfolio and wanted to get the word out about its growing range.
 “A lot of people know us for Smokeless Fire Pits, but we launched 13 new products in the last 18 months,” said Liz Vanzura, chief marketing officer of Solo Brands . “So we wanted to use this holiday gifting season to showcase all of the great holiday gifts that we offer.”
 The brand has a partnership with the NFL through the Dallas Cowboys and they do a lot of tailgating so the brand decided to team with Lynch and pitch the company as a great gift idea for backyard gatherings and tailgating.
 “Marshawn Lynch was a really good fit for us. He is super engaging and really fun,” added Vanzura. “The Gifts That Don’t Suck campaign encourages people to give memorable gifts that help you get together with your family and your friends.”
